name: skip-empty-sensitive-path-enumeration
title: Skip PR file enumeration when no sensitive paths are configured (A-014)
description: Close audit finding A-014: both the standalone (src/index.js) and durable (src/operations.js) entrypoints call listPullRequestFiles in auto/eligible routing even when the sensitive-paths policy is empty, paginating every PR file for nothing since findSensitiveFiles returns [] for empty patterns. Gate the file fetch on at least one configured sensitive pattern.
creator: sdelmas
